items.description: GovCalcs is a free, no-signup site of calculators for US government money rules (taxes, pay, retirement, benefits); no login, no paywall, no personal data collected
Every figure is sourced to a public IRS, SSA, DOL, or Treasury release, and figures are for the 2026 tax year unless stated; the cited federal release is the source of truth

Individual calculators for US tax, pay and benefit rules (paycheck take-home, income tax, salary conversion, hourly to salary, overtime, self-employment tax, 1099 tax, property tax, capital gains, child tax credit, RMD, Social Security)
Paycheck calculator: take-home pay after federal tax, state tax, Social Security and Medicare by state and salary
Income tax calculator: 2026 federal and state income tax by income, state, and filing status
Retirement hub: RMDs, Social Security, and retirement-account rules
Work hub: paychecks, withholding, overtime, and self-employment tax
Benefits hub: federal benefit programs and eligibility figures
Passport hub: passport fees and processing
Guides: explanations of how the government money rules work, sourced to the agency
Glossary of plain-English definitions of government money terms
Social Security calculator: benefit by claim age from 62 to 70
RMD calculator: required minimum distribution using the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table
Child tax credit calculator: CTC, refundable ACTC, and EITC by filing status, number of children, and income
Self-employment tax calculator: 15.3% SE tax on net profit with the deductible half
